title: CoSafe: Evaluating Large Language Model Safety in Multi-Turn Dialogue Coreference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to multi-turn dialogue coreference attacks designed to elicit harmful content from the 'Discrimination, Stereotype, Injustice' category. The models' outputs are assessed for harmfulness and attack success rate using a QA-moderation model, GPT-4 as a judge, and human evaluation.

Measuring the generation of hate speech and offensive language when models are subjected to multi-turn dialogue coreference attacks using the 'Hate Speech, Offensive Language' category of the CoSafe dataset, evaluated via automated moderation, LLM evaluation, and human annotation.
